# Pull Request

Thank you for contributing to Kview! A few checks before you open the PR:

- [ ] The PR addresses a single feature or bug fix
- [ ] `./mvnw test` passes locally (66+ tests, including the embedded-Kafka suites)
- [ ] New endpoints or features have test coverage
- [ ] Connection profile formats and existing REST endpoints stay backward compatible
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] New config options are documented in `README.md`
